snapshot.text: State-run system with high out-of-pocket payments. Compulsory health insurance has been postponed until after 2030; a health financing reform is being piloted in primary care in Sughd region.

priorities.title: Primary care financing pilot
priorities.text: A pilot of health financing reform in primary care in Sughd region.

priorities.title: Health roadmap with Russia
priorities.text: Tajikistan and Russia signed a healthcare roadmap for 2026–2027.
